clue.text: Women's wear for getting around

definitions.meaning: fabric for making skirts, a garment worn by women
going round the edge of something, avoiding it

explanation.definitionFit: The noun is cloth sold for skirts, and the verb form means passing around the border of an obstacle or issue.

clue.text: Fans turned and made off, controlled by mounted police perhaps

indicators.note: turned round, the word fans is read backwards

parts.note: fled means ran away, made off

explanation.surface: Football fans turned and fled, chased by police on horseback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' makes SNAF from FANS; a snaffle is a bridle bit, so a mounted officer's horse is controlled by one.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse fitted with a simple bit is under the rider's control.

clue.text: Critical of mean social worker

parts.note: to import is to signify or mean
an ant is a social insect, a worker

explanation.surface: Criticising an unkind social worker.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a critical matter is a vital, significant one.

clue.text: Flower material — but not for flower-arrangers!

definitions.text: Flower material — but not for flower-arrangers!

parts.words: Flower material — but not for flower-arrangers!
parts.note: flower is a river (it flows); cloth named for a Border river, which also contains a word for something no flower-arranger wants

explanation.definitionFit: Woollen cloth named after a Scottish Border river, and the word ends in an unwanted plant.

clue.text: Sped back to put in class report

indicators.note: the word for sped goes backwards

parts.note: sped means ran
to rate is to grade or class

explanation.surface: Hurried back to fill in a school report.
explanation.definitionFit: To report events is to tell or recount them.

clue.text: The German grabbing pub meal

indicators.note: one piece grabs hold of the other, so the article encloses the pub

parts.note: der is a German word for the
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A German sits in the local ordering a pub lunch.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the main evening or midday repast is a meal.

clue.text: Doesn't use properly till tears are mended

indicators.note: the torn letters are mended, put back together in a new order

explanation.surface: Misusing the cash register until rips are repaired.
explanation.definitionFit: To abuse or mishandle something is to treat it badly.

clue.text: The tipple of an emperor at one time

definitions.meaning: a hot drink of wine, water and spices
the former title of the ruler of Ethiopia

explanation.definitionFit: A spiced wine drink, and the old royal title of Abyssinia's sovereign.

clue.text: Official report to do with revolution

parts.note: re means about, to do with
a turn is a revolution

explanation.surface: An official account concerning an uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal statement submitted to an authority, such as a tax filing.

clue.text: Overdue set of books hidden

parts.note: late means overdue
NT is the New Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: A library's overdue books have been hidden away.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something dormant and concealed.

clue.text: Fruit drink — about 2p

indicators.note: the drink goes about, or around, the two letters

parts.note: ale is a drink
two Ps, two of the letter P

explanation.surface: Asking the price of a fruit juice, told it costs about two pence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts PP inside ALE; '2p' looks like money but means the letter P twice.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a common orchard produce, a type of fruit.

clue.text: A peer in the Tory party's warning to followers

indicators.note: the nobleman is placed in the political wing

parts.note: the Tory party is on the political Right
an earl is a peer of the realm

explanation.surface: A Conservative lord issues a caution to the party faithful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts EARL inside RIGHT; the Tory party is the British Conservative party, conventionally on the Right.
explanation.definitionFit: The red lamp at the back of a vehicle warns drivers following behind.

clue.text: The dragon sacked a dissolute fellow

parts.note: sacked means dismissed from a job, fired
a rake is a dissolute man of fashion

explanation.surface: A dragon of a boss dismissed a debauched employee.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic name for a fire-breathing dragon of legend.

clue.text: Revolting individual put to flight

definitions.meaning: one who rises up in revolt
the vertical part of a stair, set into a flight of steps

explanation.definitionFit: One who rises against authority, and the upright board between treads in a staircase.

clue.text: Note half-a dozen keep back, being shifty

indicators.note: the whole string of pieces is read from right to left

parts.note: E is a musical note
six is VI in Roman numerals
to keep is to save

explanation.surface: Told to hold back six of them, someone avoids a straight answer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' reverses the whole run E + VI + SAVE in one go; 'keep' looks like a fortress tower but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Shifty behaviour dodges direct answers, which is what an evasive person does.

clue.text: The traveller's changing train without point

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the shuffle surrounds the point
the word train changes, its letters shuffled

parts.note: a tine is a prong or point

explanation.surface: A traveller swaps trains without reaching the destination.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing' makes IRANT from TRAIN; 'without' (outside) puts it around TINE. The clue's 's is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who journeys from place to place.

clue.text: A moving experience

parts.note: not an emotional event but literally one in which you move from place to place

explanation.definitionFit: Going on a journey is literally an experience of moving about.

clue.text: Summoning a rising showman

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the pieces read from bottom to top

parts.note: Evita is a stage show, and a cove is a man
cove is old slang for a man

explanation.surface: Calling up a showman whose star is in the ascendant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'showman' splits into show (EVITA, the musical) and man (COVE); 'rising' turns EVITACOVE upward.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling up memories or feelings, as evocative description does.

clue.text: Split about always being deferential

indicators.note: the tear goes about, around, the word for always

parts.note: rent means torn, split
ever means always

explanation.surface: A divided group always defers.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing deep respect, as deferential people do.

clue.text: Habit that causes a non-drinker annoyance

parts.note: TT is teetotal, a non-drinker
ire is anger or annoyance

explanation.surface: A teetotaller finds some custom irritating.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit is clothing such as a monk's garb, so it means dress.

clue.text: Expected to divide the tip provided

indicators.note: one piece divides the other, sitting in its middle

parts.note: the end is the tip
due means expected

explanation.surface: Waiters were meant to share the gratuity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to divide' puts DUE inside END; 'tip' looks like a gratuity.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic sense: endowed, supplied with a quality.

clue.text: Hand back all remaining foreign currency

parts.note: the rest is all that remains
the ore is a Scandinavian coin

explanation.surface: Returning the leftover foreign money after a holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: The ore is a small coin of Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
explanation.definitionFit: To give something back to its owner is to restore it.

clue.text: Spare serving men wait at table

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, men serving in the army
to serve is to wait at table

explanation.surface: Extra footmen wait at dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a spare is a backup held in reserve.

clue.text: Examines 19 in addition

indicators.note: the garment goes in the addition

parts.note: PS, a postscript, is an addition to a letter
19 across is a word for dress, as is robe

explanation.surface: Checks clothing on top of everything else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts ROBE inside PS; 19 points to the answer to 19 across, which means dress.
explanation.definitionFit: To investigate closely is to probe.

clue.text: Some veteran generally creates a row

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An old soldier usually starts an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: To range things is to set them out in a line, so it means arranging in a row.

clue.text: Better Mediterranean holiday place on little river

parts.note: Nice is a resort on the French Riviera
R is short for river

explanation.surface: A Riviera resort beside a small stream is preferable.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative: more pleasant means better.

clue.text: "It is a characteristic of wisdom not to do _____ things", (Thoreau)

definitions.text: "It is a characteristic of wisdom not to do _____ things", (Thoreau)

parts.words: "It is a characteristic of wisdom not to do _____ things", (Thoreau)
parts.note: a fill-in-the-blank: the missing word completes the quotation from Walden

explanation.definitionFit: Thoreau's line in Walden says wisdom avoids reckless, hopeless acts.

clue.text: An African animal which may well be laden

indicators.note: the animal may well be the word laden in another order

explanation.surface: An African beast of burden heavily loaded.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a large antelope of Africa.

clue.text: Taking the cure can be a disguise for the unscrupulous adventurer

indicators.note: the words are disguised, their letters rearranged to hide the result

explanation.surface: A rogue takes a cure that may mask his villainy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a disguise for' says to rearrange the letters of CURE CAN BE.
explanation.definitionFit: A pirate is a lawless seafaring adventurer.

clue.text: A number turn cold when this woman appears

parts.note: L is fifty in Roman numerals
to ice is to freeze, turn cold

explanation.surface: Several people go cold when a certain woman walks in.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, so it stands for a woman.

clue.text: Pledge to provide, running water in an animal shelter

indicators.note: the river sits in the pen

parts.note: a sty is a pen for pigs
the Ure is a Yorkshire river

explanation.surface: A promise to supply a water trough in the pigsty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts URE, a river in Yorkshire, inside STY.
explanation.definitionFit: A guarantee or bond given as security is a surety.

clue.text: Trade he's whipped up will get capital support

indicators.note: whipped up like cream, the letters are churned into a new order

explanation.surface: Business he stirs up will gain backing from the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'whipped up' rearranges TRADE HES; capital here means the head.
explanation.definitionFit: A cushion on a seat supports the head, the capital of the body.
